_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Iron Man.
Found by watching 164 candidate addresses (0x021108F0-0x02110B7C, 4-byte ints) through an automated 2-player game:
0x021109E4 held the previous game's 1,409,790, went to 0 at start and rose with player 1 only; 0x021109E8 rose from 0
with player 2 only (final 1,019,850 / 1,542,400). Same base and 4-byte stride as trn_174h; players 3 and 4 follow the stride.
player_count at 0x02110900, the one address shared by every SAM game checked; it read 2 during the game.
No game over flag: the leaderboards use the 'GameOn' fast flips solenoid 33 of PinMAME (score-rules.json).
